Laura —

Thanks for the heads up. I updated Eng objectives in the scoring template (see attached tab). Quick notes:

- OBJ-ENG-1 (throughput/latency): I put 0.8. We hit the 25% latency improvement on hosted API but had a rollback for a quantization experiment that cost some throughput — confidence medium.
- OBJ-ENG-2 (reliability): 0.9 — incident MTTR reduced and Dedicated SLA met for 95% uptime this quarter.
- OBJ-ENG-3 (private deployments): 0.6 — two delayed on-prem installs pushed timelines out.

I've included a short narrative for each objective under the "Narrative" column. Flagging OBJ-ENG-3 for calibration with Product and CS.

Laura / all —

I've reviewed the submitted narratives and scores so far. Two calibration calls outs:

1) Sales-influence on OBJ-ENG-3: Monica, Markus marked this lower due to on-prem delays, however we booked three high-value renewals that were contingent on the on-prem roadmap. Suggest we split the objective into "technical delivery" and "revenue enablement" for clearer scoring and mention the renewals as an impact highlight.

2) Bias on reliability: Markus's 0.9 looks reasonable; please add one line about the recent 3-hour incident in Feb and the corrective action (automated failover) to the narrative so Board Ops has the context.

I've attached a short PDF with calibration suggestions (OKR_calibration_notes.pdf). I'll be on the Tue 09:00 calibrations call.

Evelyn Hart
